plans.original_plan:
Day 1:
Warm-up: 7 mins light jogging & dynamic leg swings
Main Workout: 3x12 Bodyweight Squats, 3x10 Push-ups, 3x15 Walking Lunges, 20 mins interval cycling
Cooldown: 5 mins static hamstring and calf stretching

Day 2:
Warm-up: 5 mins jump rope & arm circles
Main Workout: 3x12 Dumbbell Deadlifts, 3x10 Dumbbell Rows, 3x30s Plank holds
Cooldown: Child's pose and deep diaphragmatic breathing

Day 3:
Warm-up: 8 mins incline treadmill walk
Main Workout: HIIT circuit (Burpees, Mountain Climbers, Kettlebell Swings) - 4 rounds of 45s work / 15s rest
Cooldown: Full body quad and shoulder stretch

Day 4:
Warm-up: 6 mins mobility flow & cat-cow
Main Workout: Active recovery - 35 mins brisk walking or easy swimming
Cooldown: Gentle foam rolling for calves and lower back

Day 5:
Warm-up: 5 mins jumping jacks & hip openers
Main Workout: 3x12 Goblet Squats, 3x10 Overhead Dumbbell Press, 3x12 Glute Bridges
Cooldown: Hamstring & glute stretches

Day 6:
Warm-up: 7 mins rower machine warmup
Main Workout: 25 mins tempo cardio run + 3x15 Hanging knee raises
Cooldown: 5 mins cool walking & thoracic spine rotations

Day 7:
Warm-up: 5 mins gentle neck and shoulder circles
Main Workout: Full body restorative stretch & 20 mins leisure walk
Cooldown: Deep meditative breathing and hydration

plans.original_plan:
Day 1 (Chest & Triceps):
Warm-up: 8 mins rowing & band dislocates
Main Workout: Barbell Bench Press 4x8, Incline Dumbbell Press 3x10, Cable Flyes 3x12, Tricep Rope Pushdowns 3x12
Cooldown: Chest doorway stretch & tricep extension stretch

Day 2 (Back & Biceps):
Warm-up: 6 mins dynamic arm swings & scapular pull-ups
Main Workout: Conventional Deadlift 4x6, Barbell Bent-over Rows 4x8, Lat Pulldowns 3x10, Barbell Bicep Curls 3x10
Cooldown: Lat stretch on rack & child's pose

Day 3 (Legs & Calves):
Warm-up: 8 mins stationary bike & leg swings
Main Workout: Barbell Back Squats 4x8, Romanian Deadlifts 3x10, Leg Press 3x12, Standing Calf Raises 4x15
Cooldown: Quad foam rolling & seated hamstring stretch

Day 4 (Shoulders & Abs):
Warm-up: 5 mins light overhead press & lateral raises
Main Workout: Standing Overhead Press 4x8, Dumbbell Lateral Raises 4x12, Face Pulls 3x15, Hanging Leg Raises 3x12
Cooldown: Cross-body shoulder stretch & cobra stretch

Day 5 (Upper Body Hypertrophy):
Warm-up: 6 mins elliptical machine
Main Workout: Weighted Dips 3x8, Pull-ups 3x8, Incline Dumbbell Flyes 3x12, Incline Dumbbell Curls 3x12
Cooldown: Upper body stretching flow

Day 6 (Lower Body Hypertrophy):
Warm-up: 7 mins dynamic mobility
Main Workout: Front Squats 3x8, Walking Dumbbell Lunges 3x12 per leg, Hamstring Curls 3x12, Seated Calf Raises 3x15
Cooldown: 8 mins deep leg stretching

Day 7 (Rest & Recovery):
Warm-up: 5 mins gentle walk
Main Workout: Full rest day - light 20 mins stroll to promote blood flow
Cooldown: Hydration and 8+ hours quality sleep
plans.nutrition_tip: Target 1.8g to 2.2g of protein per kg of body weight, and consume 30-40g of protein within 90 minutes post-workout for optimal muscle protein synthesis.

plans.original_plan:
Day 1:
Warm-up: 6-8 mins of light dynamic mobility (arm circles, torso twists, leg swings, hip openers)
Main Workout (Flexibility & Endurance Focus - Medium Intensity):
- Exercise 1: Compound Squat variation - 3-4 sets of 10-12 reps
- Exercise 2: Push-up or Dumbbell Bench Press - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Exercise 3: Dumbbell Bent-over Row - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Exercise 4: Walking Lunges - 3 sets of 10 reps per leg
- Cardio/Finisher: 12-15 mins moderate pace interval cycling or brisk incline treadmill walk
Cooldown: 5-7 mins static hamstring, quad, and chest doorway stretches

Day 2:
Warm-up: 5 mins light skipping rope or jumping jacks + shoulder dislocates
Main Workout (Flexibility & Endurance Focus - Medium Intensity):
- Exercise 1: Romanian Deadlifts or Glute Bridges - 3 sets of 10-12 reps
- Exercise 2: Overhead Shoulder Press - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Exercise 3: Lat Pulldown or Bodyweight Inverted Rows - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Exercise 4: Forearm Plank - 3 sets of 30-45 second holds
Cooldown: Child's pose, cat-cow flow, and deep diaphragmatic breathing for 5 mins

Day 3:
Warm-up: 7 mins dynamic yoga flow (Sun Salutations A & B)
Main Workout (Core, Agility & Conditioning):
- Exercise 1: Mountain Climbers - 3 sets of 30 seconds
- Exercise 2: Kettlebell / Dumbbell Swings - 3 sets of 15 reps
- Exercise 3: Side Plank holds - 3 sets of 20 seconds each side
- Exercise 4: Russian Twists - 3 sets of 20 total touches
Cooldown: 8 mins full body restorative stretch with deep box breathing

Day 4:
Warm-up: 5 mins gentle neck, ankle, and wrist mobility
Main Workout (Active Recovery & Aerobic Base):
- 30 to 45 mins low-impact aerobic activity (brisk nature walk, swimming, or light stationary cycling at conversation pace)
Cooldown: 10 mins gentle foam rolling targeting calves, IT bands, and thoracic spine

Day 5:
Warm-up: 7 mins light jog and high knees + butt kicks
Main Workout (Flexibility & Endurance Strength & Hypertrophy):
- Exercise 1: Goblet Squats or Front Squats - 4 sets of 10 reps
- Exercise 2: Incline Dumbbell Chest Press - 3 sets of 10-12 reps
- Exercise 3: Single-arm Dumbbell Rows - 3 sets of 10 reps each side
- Exercise 4: Standing Calf Raises - 3 sets of 15 reps
Cooldown: Cobra stretch, seated forward fold, and shoulder cross-body stretch

Day 6:
Warm-up: 6 mins rowing machine or elliptical ramp-up
Main Workout (Functional Conditioning & Stamina):
- Exercise 1: Dumbbell Step-ups - 3 sets of 10 reps per leg
- Exercise 2: Bicep Curls to Overhead Press combo - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Exercise 3: Tricep Dips or Overhead Extensions - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Exercise 4: Bicycle Crunches - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Finisher: 10 mins steady-state aerobic cool-down
Cooldown: 6 mins full posterior chain stretching

Day 7:
Warm-up: 5 mins joint mobility rotations
Main Workout (Restoration & Mindful Recovery):
- 20 mins light mobility flow & deep hip openers (Pigeon pose, Butterfly stretch)
- 10 mins guided meditation or breathwork
Cooldown: Hydrate with 500ml water and electrolytes; prep meals and rest for the week ahead!
